name: Mediawiki
description: MediaWiki is a collaboration and documentation platform brought to you by a vibrant community.
composeYaml:
services:
  mediawiki:
    image: 'mediawiki:latest'
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'mediawiki-images:/var/www/html/images'
      - 'mediawiki-sqlite:/var/www/html/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost:80'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Wiki software package that powers Wikipedia and all other Wikimedia projects, serving hundreds of millions of users each month.
